notes: Fixed World Clock sometimes losing saved clocks after a restart. Tickets now show who on the team sent each reply internally. Fixed tickets occasionally not showing up yet in search/lookups right after being created or imported. Added Ticket Rules (Settings → Ticket Rules) to automatically tag, prioritize, set status, or assign a ticket the moment it's created.
